scores.tell: The table and stools are spread across a full landscape scene (path, trees, bushes). The hero is small and sits low and wide, with edge-to-edge scenery competing with it. Real cards like the swing are also scenic, so this is near but off. The right stool is close to the edge and the pieces read as a group rather than one hero.

The coffin is centered, upright and large, and it fills most of the card height. Its base sits near the bottom, with clear margins left and right. The background is a plain lawn and the object is named at once. The only tell is that it is dead-centered, perfectly upright and symmetric. Real cards usually tilt or angle the hero.

none. The calculator is tilted and large, and it fills the card with tight margins. The pattern is a flat backdrop that doesn't compete, much like the towel and whistle cards. It is instantly readable at thumbnail size.
